children: Our Bureau Bengaluru: Ather Insurance, electric two-wheeler maker Ather Energy's wholly owned subsidiary, has received regulatory approval to distribute and service insurance policies, as the company looks to diversify revenue and generate recurring income from its existing customer base.

The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India granted the subsidiary a certificate of registration on October 15 to act as a corporate agent (composite), Ather Energy said in a stock exchange filing on Thursday. The registration covers life, general and health insurance.

The approval is for insurance distribution and servicing, rather than underwriting policies. Ather, in its filings, said the move would diversify its revenue streams. The registration remains valid from October 15, subject to payment of an annual fee, unless suspended or cancelled by the regulator, according to the filing. Ather, ranked third in India's electric two-wheeler market in September, with 30,479 registrations and a 14.71% share, Vahan data showed. TVS Motor led with 26.06%, followed by Bajaj Auto at 23.36%. Ola Electric had a 6.49% share.

title: Ather Insurance Gets IRDAI Nod to Distribute Policies
